propositions: The sync route deliberately suppresses OK: stdout summary per __main__.py:437 gate and docs/exit-codes.md contract, yet two DC harness test assertions expected OK: in output after commit c87afedba8 re-pointed cells to sync.
The canonical sync route emits BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr (not stdout) and bare RECON: telemetry lines (differ totals and batch_outcome mutations), not OK: summaries.

BRIDGE_STATE: converged alone does not prove zero writes because __main__.py classifies passes that applied N mutations as CONVERGED; idempotence must also assert zero differ totals and zero batch_outcome lines.

Test helpers _assert_converged_writing_pass and _assert_wrote_nothing must be rewritten to parse stderr BRIDGE_STATE and RECON telemetry instead of stdout OK: line, with parsing logic moved to a dependency-free module for unit testability.
Two live cells must remain enabled and green against real Jira DC without deletions, skips, or xfail markers.
